name: Dots, lines and typed text
what: White dots hang on a dark screen while the whole scene zooms in slowly. Thin glowing lines connect them one after another, a line runs in from the left edge, the text is typed letter by letter beside the big dot, and the dots on the right connect too, with a last line running off the frame.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f100 the whole scene zooms in 25 % (S-curve, slow start); f24-f34 a line runs in from the left edge to the first dot; f39-f44 it continues down to the big dot; f44-f56 the text is typed, letter by letter (about 1.6 f apart, hard cuts); f57-f61 the right-hand big dot connects to the small one; f61-f66 a last line runs off the right edge; then the scene holds still while the zoom finishes

tracks.name: slow zoom
tracks.what: the whole scene (dots, lines, text) zooms in about its middle

tracks.name: line in
tracks.what: a line runs in from off the left edge to the first dot

tracks.name: line down
tracks.what: it continues from the first dot to the big dot

tracks.name: typed text
tracks.what: the letters appear one by one, no fade

tracks.name: last line
tracks.what: a line runs from the small right dot off the right edge

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: everything stands still while the zoom finishes (the film grain moves)
